Name: Prismatic butterfly notifier
Author: mistyspring
Description:
[size=3]This mod was made to make finding the butterfly easier.

[b][u]How it works:[/u][/b]
Once you enter the map the butterfly is in, you'll receive a notification.

You can toggle a config option to also show the coordinates it's in.[/size]

[size=3][url=https://github.com/misty-spring/StardewMods/tree/main/PrismaticButterflyNotifier]Source code[/url][/size]

Manifest.Name: Prismatic butterfly notifier
Manifest.Description: Notifies you where the prismatic butterfly has spawned.
